lines.text: Ten people prayed the same desperate prayer, and all ten got the same miracle on the same road.
Nine of them just kept walking — new life, new plans, no reason left to look back.
And with a loud voice glorified God, and fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks.
Whatever He's already done for you, don't let the thank-you be the part of the prayer you forgot to finish.

bold: the part of the prayer you forgot to finish
title: Word and Faith Network
subtitle: Where Are the Nine?
story: Ten robed travelers scatter down a sunlit, dusty road at midday, already walking off in every direction without a backward glance. One breaks away, turning back into warm amber light with arms lifting in praise. In the final scene he falls at the feet of a gold-rimmed figure under a deep golden glow — the one prayer that got finished with thanks.
